preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(char, str) and len(char) == 1 for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output list must contain only single-character strings.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [char for char in s if s.count(char) % 2 != 0]
postconditions.description: The output list must contain all characters that appear an odd number of times in the input string, in the order of their last occurrence.
